audience: HR and people teams that run employee recognition and awards in Motivosity

useCases.title: Find the most recognized people this month
useCases.text: Read the leaderboard for this month, this year or the top 10. Read the recent recognition feed with its likes and comments.

useCases.title: Check the org chart around one manager
useCases.text: Search users by name or email. List the direct reports of a manager, or the org chart around one user.

useCases.title: Read company values and feed by date
useCases.text: List the company values. Read the feed items for a date range, including upcoming birthdays and anniversaries.

useCases.title: Post a value-based appreciation
useCases.text: Post a platform appreciation to one or more people, tagged with a company value. The company can see it.

useCases.title: Give a central-budget award
useCases.text: Give an award to one or more people. A service account can give only central-budget awards.
